results.question: 恒瑞医药和万科A谁的毛利率更高
results.sql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (ts_code) ts_code, end_date FROM fin.income
            WHERE ts_code IN ('600276.SH', '000002.SZ') AND report_type='1'
            ORDER BY ts_code, end_date DESC)
SELECT s.name AS stock_name, i.end_date, f.grossprofit_margin AS value
FROM fin.income i
JOIN latest t ON t.ts_code = i.ts_code AND t.end_date = i.end_date
JOIN stock.stock_basic s ON i.ts_code = s.ts_code
LEFT JOIN fin.fina_indicator f
    ON i.ts_code = f.ts_code AND i.end_date = f.end_date AND i.report_type = f.report_type
LEFT JOIN fin.balancesheet b
    ON i.ts_code = b.ts_code AND i.end_date = b.end_date AND i.report_type = b.report_type
LEFT JOIN fin.cashflow c
    ON i.ts_code = c.ts_code AND i.end_date = c.end_date AND i.report_type = c.report_type
WHERE i.report_type = '1'
ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 30

results.question: 山西汾酒和深振业A谁净利润高
results.sql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (ts_code) ts_code, end_date FROM fin.income
            WHERE ts_code IN ('000006.SZ', '600809.SH') AND report_type='1'
            ORDER BY ts_code, end_date DESC)
SELECT s.name AS stock_name, i.end_date, i.n_income_attr_p AS value
FROM fin.income i
JOIN latest t ON t.ts_code = i.ts_code AND t.end_date = i.end_date
JOIN stock.stock_basic s ON i.ts_code = s.ts_code
LEFT JOIN fin.fina_indicator f
    ON i.ts_code = f.ts_code AND i.end_date = f.end_date AND i.report_type = f.report_type
LEFT JOIN fin.balancesheet b
    ON i.ts_code = b.ts_code AND i.end_date = b.end_date AND i.report_type = b.report_type
LEFT JOIN fin.cashflow c
    ON i.ts_code = c.ts_code AND i.end_date = c.end_date AND i.report_type = c.report_type
WHERE i.report_type = '1'
ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 30

LEFT JOIN fin.cashflow c
    ON i.ts_code = c.ts_code AND i.end_date = c.end_date AND i.report_type = c.report_type

results.question: 查一下平安银行和宁德时代的收入
results.sql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (ts_code) ts_code, end_date FROM fin.income
            WHERE ts_code IN ('000001.SZ', '300750.SZ') AND report_type='1'
            ORDER BY ts_code, end_date DESC)
SELECT s.name AS stock_name, i.end_date, i.revenue AS value
FROM fin.income i
JOIN latest t ON t.ts_code = i.ts_code AND t.end_date = i.end_date
JOIN stock.stock_basic s ON i.ts_code = s.ts_code
LEFT JOIN fin.fina_indicator f
    ON i.ts_code = f.ts_code AND i.end_date = f.end_date AND i.report_type = f.report_type
LEFT JOIN fin.balancesheet b
    ON i.ts_code = b.ts_code AND i.end_date = b.end_date AND i.report_type = b.report_type
LEFT JOIN fin.cashflow c
    ON i.ts_code = c.ts_code AND i.end_date = c.end_date AND i.report_type = c.report_type
WHERE i.report_type = '1'
ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 30

SELECT i.ts_code, s.name AS stock_name, i.end_date, f.current_ratio
FROM fin.income i
JOIN stock.stock_basic s ON i.ts_code = s.ts_code
LEFT JOIN fin.fina_indicator f
    ON i.ts_code = f.ts_code AND i.end_date = f.end_date AND i.report_type = f.report_type
LEFT JOIN fin.balancesheet b
    ON i.ts_code = b.ts_code AND i.end_date = b.end_date AND i.report_type = b.report_type
LEFT JOIN fin.cashflow c
    ON i.ts_code = c.ts_code AND i.end_date = c.end_date AND i.report_type = c.report_type
WHERE i.ts_code = '002371.SZ' AND i.report_type = '1' AND i.end_date = '2024-12-31'
ORDER BY i.end_date DESC
LIMIT 12
